text:
jessica_cs: Quick heads-up — during onboarding call with Parkwell today they asked for a centralized 'snippet hub' in the console to store canned prompts/templates for CS & product docs. They said it's a blocker for scaling enablement across accounts.

diego_cse: Nice, can you paste the raw asks? any examples?

jessica_cs: Sure — two asks: 1) shared editable snippet library (per-org + global) with tags and versioning; 2) per-route snippet suggestions surfaced in the runbook when a user sees high latency/errors.

marta_enablement: +1 for tags/versioning. They also want ACLs so only account admins or SEs can edit. Without ACLs, they'll see it as security risk.

tom_product: Thanks — sounds like two feature areas: a content library (UI + RBAC + versioning) and contextual suggestion hooks. Do we have any safety/PII concerns if customers store prompts?

jessica_cs: Parkwell said they'd store customer-facing templates (no secrets) but some teams might paste system prompts. They asked for optional redaction or KMS flagging.

ops_bot: Reminder — raise a security review ticket if a customer requests KMS/HSM integration. Use /ticket new-security-review with account tag.

diego_cse: For prioritization: Parkwell is a MRR mid-market account up for renewal in 6 months. If we ship a lightweight snippet library (no KMS) in Q2, could reduce their churn risk.

marta_enablement: Proposal: MVP scope = shared snippets + per-org tags + role-based edit permissions. No versioning/KMS for MVP. Shipable in 6 weeks if eng can allocate a sprint.

tom_product: I'll flag this as a candidate for the feature bucket "Enablement tooling". Can you capture a short PRD ticket with: customer quote, acceptance criteria (create/edit/list, ACLs, tagging), rough rollout plan? I'll judge priority against roadmap.

jessica_cs: On it. Quote: "Our support SEs need a place to store consistent prompts — right now we're losing time re-writing same snippets and it's causing inconsistent responses to customers."

diego_cse: Acceptance criteria draft: 
- Users with "snippet_editor" role can create/edit/delete snippets
- Snippets can be tagged and filtered
- Snippets surfaced via a per-route suggestion chip when a route hits >80th percentile latency or error
- Admin can export snippet usage metrics

marta_enablement: Also add: rollback to previous snippet version (for accidental bad edits) — maybe mark as stretch.

tom_product: Stretch noted. For prioritization, I'll add: MVP (must-have): create/list/edit, ACL, tagging, basic UI. Stretch: versioning, autosuggestions, KMS.

jessica_cs: I'll attach meeting notes and ask Parkwell if they'd be willing to pilot the MVP. If they are, that bumps priority. :eyes:

ops_bot: Ticket created: #CS-4983 (snippet-hub-mvp) — assigned to tom_product for triage.

diego_cse: Perfect. Can we also include a short survey question for other onboarded accounts: "Would a shared snippet library reduce time-to-resolution for your team?" 1-5 scale. I can send to 12 recent customers.

jessica_cs: Please do. Send to the 12 with onboarding in last 90 days. I'll compile responses in the PRD.

tom_product: Great — thanks everyone. Will triage ticket tomorrow and follow up in this thread with initial estimate. :thumbsup:
